subject: Power BI: Scheduled refresh disabled for 'Orders Daily Rollup'
body:
Hi Contoso BI team,

Scheduled refresh has been disabled for the semantic model 'Orders Daily Rollup' following four consecutive failures.

Workspace: Contoso - Sales Operations (workspaceId: b8e42d17-3f6a-4c9b-8d21-77e4a1c9f003)
Dataset: Orders Daily Rollup (datasetId: 4e6b1d90-3c72-4a58-8f19-b27ec5a40d83)
Disabled: 2026-08-28T05:04:12Z

Error code: ScheduledRefreshDisabled
Detail: The scheduled refresh schedule was deactivated automatically after four consecutive failures (ModelRefreshFailed_CredentialsNotSpecified). Scheduled refresh will not resume until it is re-enabled in semantic model settings.

No further refresh failure notifications will be sent for this model while the schedule is disabled.

- Power BI service
